name: Shin Ringetsu
source:
A long time ago a certain region was plagued by monsters. Lord of the land exterminated youkai every day, but a powerful youkai put a curse on his family. The curse is to never bear males again. To prevent the effects of the curse every three generation a bride must be taken from Hizuki clan known for spiritual power.

Modern times. Naoto Rindo is a new successor to the powerful Rindo conglomerate. Unfortunately, his bride and childhood friend from Hizuki clan suddenly dies, so he needs to find a new Hizuki bride really fast. He starts to live in Hizuki family to get to know four sisters there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]


A remake that, by requests from the original game's consumers, adds Suzune's route, removes harem route, and slightly modifies the story.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/燐月-リンゲツ-]wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，某个地区饱受妖怪侵扰。当地领主日复一日地消灭妖怪，却被一只强大的妖怪诅咒：他的家族将再也无法诞下男性。为了抑制诅咒的影响，每隔三代，家族都必须从以灵力闻名的绯月一族迎娶新娘。

到了现代，龙胆直人成为实力雄厚的龙胆财团的新一任继承人。不幸的是，他出身绯月一族的未婚妻兼青梅竹马突然去世，他必须尽快找到另一位绯月家的新娘。为了了解那里的四姐妹，他开始寄住在绯月家。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]


本作是重制版，应原作玩家的要求追加了铃音路线，删除后宫路线，并对故事作了小幅修改。

[翻译并编辑自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/燐月-リンゲツ-]Wikipedia[/url]]
